units.speaker: Anna
units.text: So that's Old Town. A fire, a rebuild, a booth, and a rib.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: And a secret door, though I'd call that a legend.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: I'd call it a perfect story.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Both. From here, it's a twelve-minute rideshare south, about two and a third miles, back to the hotel.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: You'll have your late checkout at four, then the airport.
